title: Remote witness command shape (`ulimit …; env -u … K=V … node scripts/test-launcher.mjs …`) is not recognized as a test, so no provider observation or native completion forms
outcome: Remote witness command shape (`ulimit …; env -u … K=V … node scripts/test-launcher.mjs …`) is not recognized as a test, so no provider observation or native completion forms
acceptance: A DL560 runner can issue a focused or full launcher request with its required environment (private HOME/TMPDIR/CARGO_HOME, unset RUN_ROOT/TRACE, raised file limit) in a form the host recognizes as the test command, so the run gets its provider observation and native completion; shown by a behaviour test with that exact shape (or the documented supported shape the runner switches to).
If a command shape is not recognized, the reason is reported per the refusal rule (memory design-rule-refusals-explain-themselves-2026-11-15) instead of silently treating it as not a test.
